changelog: - **SSO role mapping speaks the vertical's words and offers only its roles** (#2839). The IdP role-mapping card labels roles through `usersAdmin.*` (a MARKETING tenant reads rep/lead, not MENTOR/MENTEE) and its three hints gain MARKETING overlay entries — they named the enum in uppercase, which the leak ratchet strips as a code. `mappableRolesFor(capabilities)` in `ssoRoleMapping.ts` drops a role whose module the vertical lacks (SOURCE without `sourcing`, COMPANY without `companies`): the API offers and accepts only that list (`role_not_in_vertical`), and the ACS ignores a stray row the way it ignores ADMIN.

en: The SSO role mapping now uses your product's own role names and offers only the roles your product has.
tr: SSO rol eşleme artık ürününüzün kendi rol adlarını kullanıyor ve yalnızca ürününüzde bulunan rolleri sunuyor.
de: Die SSO-Rollenzuordnung verwendet jetzt die Rollennamen Ihres Produkts und bietet nur die Rollen an, die es dort gibt.
